\subsection*{S3. Meshes, solvers and runtimes}
Production mesh: graded $h_{xy}=1.1$~mm grid with every in-plane interval split in two (r21); 8-node hexahedra (thermal C3D8, structural C3D8I incompatible modes); CalculiX~2.23. Thermal: steady conduction, direct solver; E--T stop: every coupled region temperature changes $<0.25$~K and the loss $<0.1$\,\%; coolant energy balance iterated to 0.02~K. Structural: linear thermoelastic, $T_{\mathrm{ref}}=25\,^\circ$C, rigid-body motion restrained only, ITERATIVE CHOLESKY (verified against the direct SPOOLES solver to $10^{-4}$ on the base mesh). Machine: two-socket Intel Xeon Gold 6342 (2.8~GHz, 48 cores), shared; thermal solves on 2 threads, structural on 1.
\begin{tabular}{@{}lrrrrrrr@{}}
\toprule
 & Nodes & Elements & Struct.\ DOF & E--T iter. & E--T (s) & Struct.\ (s) & Total (h) \\
\midrule
Z1 & 153{,}873 & 144{,}512 & 461{,}619 & 5 & 2875 & 1952 & 1.3 \\
Z2 & 159{,}241 & 145{,}120 & 477{,}723 & 5 & 2887 & 3646 & 1.8 \\
Z3 & 135{,}731 & 126{,}536 & 407{,}193 & 4 & 8737 & 1370 & 2.8 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}

Times exclude geometry construction and meshing (under 2~min per architecture), the local solder submodel (reported in S6) and postprocessing; they include every E--T iteration (each a thermal solve with its coolant balance) and the structural solve with the all-site joint search. Sensitivity runs repeat the same chain.
